scope: Private canonical BREP + full-placement bounds parity, no production publication reordering
qualification: Functional stage observations only; no isolated performance claim. All CAD/store writes are under models/tmp. Archived and current runtime sources are unchanged.
timingInterpretation: One functional observation per cache state, no controlled repeated or interleaved timing. Control = materialize_descriptor + whole-document _bbox_from_shape. Candidate = verified BREP/SURF reads + measurement lookup/derivation + merge, excludes descriptor capture/flattening, appearance/document assembly and publication. Candidate cold-key executes after control, so existing inner occurrence-bounds memo can be warm. RAM/disk refers only to outer measurement cache; no end-to-end gain is established.
scopeLimits: No transparent Compound or publication-path modification.
Private geometry only; no native shape is stored in the new cache.
No STEP export/readback parity test in this spike.
Missing/corrupt root checks occur during descriptor capture; component checks occur on each measurement call.
Existing op index format is reused; valid-but-false numeric index tampering is not authenticated, as with existing value memos.
Seven fixtures plus implementation inspection support an enforceable narrow boundary, not all arbitrary native shapes or user callbacks.
